text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
document outlines 
the checklist 
I1, which must be carried out on 
an annually bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the above title block
The 
first draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Esmail Fouad, eng. Khalil Ahmad 3awad, the 
internet assistance by eng. Mohamed Selim Salman with MPIS office at EEHC, the 
document field tested at 12 Jan 2003, revised by quality control eng. Abdel 
Menem AlEmam at EDEPCo., accepted by general director; eng. Mohamed El Sayed 
Abdel Ghafar, and approved by eng Awad Mohamed Fathy Head Sector of El-Aresh 
Power Station
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
Tools and Equipments
Safety helmet, shoes,
Oven temperature > 500 deg. C.
Voltmeter, mv 
 ohmmeter.
Work to be carried out
Steps to prepare for test
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Obtain copy of the setting value of thermocouple.
Disconnect thermocouple wires and isolate the wires using tape.
Remove thermocouple and take it to lab.
Testing Procedure
Put the thermocouple into the oven and connect mv 
 meter to thermocouple 
 terminals.
Adjust oven temp. to the ref. value, wait 5 
 minutes, record voltmeter reading and compare it 
 with the correct value.
Repeat step 2 but for the other
 degrees C.
Return thermocouple to 
Service
Return thermocouple to service by removing the 
 oven from the indicator vent.
Close indicator vent.
Open the manual isolating valve of indicator line.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.
